visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a white tray holding nine square dessert cups, each topped with strawberries and different creams, including matcha, cocoa, and lemon. A pair of hands wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt rotates the tray on a rustic wooden table under bright indoor lighting. (2) Individual cakes are showcased in handheld close-ups: a matcha green cream cake with a pink button chocolate, a tiramisu cake being scooped with a metal spoon, and a lemon-topped square. The background remains the blurred wooden surface of the bakery table. (3) A large dome-shaped cake covered entirely in fresh strawberries resembles a Christmas tree, complete with a lit star candle on top. A metal server lifts a slice to reveal yellow custard and white sponge layers. (4) Another round cake, the 'gift cake,' is shown wrapped in white chocolate ribbons and a bow, densely packed with strawberries and cream dots. A hand presents the cake to the camera. (5) The camera pans across a refrigerated glass display case in a bakery, showing rows of various fruit-topped cakes and canned desserts with labels. (6) The final shot shows the storefront of 'Wenting Bakery' (薇庭烘焙) with a large poster of a female chef and the shop's address displayed on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice begins narrating with a moderate, energetic pitch and clear articulation. The background music is a bright, acoustic pop track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming and a steady light drum beat at approximately 110 BPM. (2) As the narrator describes specific cake flavors like 'matcha' and 'earl grey,' a faint plastic scraping sound is audible as a spoon enters a dessert cup. The music bed remains constant in volume and tempo. (3) The narration continues with higher emotional energy when describing the 'Christmas tree' cake, while the acoustic guitar and light percussion maintain a cheerful, major-mode atmosphere. (4) The audio concludes with the narrator providing the shop's location and a friendly sign-off, followed by a smooth fade-out of the background music.
